plan: possession-v4 (broadcast tracking as a second ball source)
context: v2.1 is the submission system; Smart Tagging (v3.0/v3.1) was not selected. The tactical ball is missing on 41% of graded frames (DATA.md); the broadcast ATD has its own ball track (50.5% of its frames) on a different, unsynchronised timeline. An oracle check (perfectly aligned fill of 30% of frames, 1 m noise) is running for reporting only.

candidate.base: v2.1 unchanged (same frozen bundle, stage 1, stage 2 and decoder; no retraining)
candidate.change: before inference, fill missing tactical ball positions from the aligned broadcast ball (possession/broadcast.py)
candidate.alignment: orientation/team mapping by global ball NCC and player matching; per half: coarse lag from masked normalised cross-correlation of ball x/y (FFT, >= 120 s overlap); 60 s windows (step 30 s) refine the lag within +-12 frames by matching visible broadcast players to tactical players of the same team; a broadcast frame is accepted only if >= 3 of its players match at median distance <= 2.0 m at the mapped tactical frame (replays and close-ups fail)
candidate.fusion: fill only frames where the tactical ball is missing; reject a fill farther than 35 m/s x dt + 2 m from the nearest tactical ball within 0.5 s; global gate: at least 5% of broadcast frames accepted, >= 120 s of frames where both cameras see the ball, and >= 70% of those within 2.0 m, otherwise no fusion
candidate.constants: fixed a priori in possession/broadcast.py before any v4 result; not tuned

validation.copies: the 8 v2.1 validation copies (DFL J03WN1, J03WR9, Metrica 1-2; degrade seeds 101/102)
validation.synthetic_broadcast: generated from the CLEAN external match: per-half offset with slow drift (+-3e-5), broadcast start/end margins, 30-120 s studio gap between halves, replays at dead-ball moments (4-12 s, content 6-15 s in the past, half of them slow motion, 30% with valid homography), close-ups (invalid fraction 0.15-0.30, mean run 3 s), camera window around the ball (half-size 18-30 m x 12-20 m), per-shot calibration bias (sd 0-1.5 m, shots of 3-10 s), player noise 0.2-1.0 m, ball available on 55-85% of valid live frames (mean run 2 s) with noise 0.2-1.0 m and 1% outliers, one player slot with a wrong team

regimes.bad: calibration bias sd 3-5 m and ball noise 3-5 m
regimes.none: no broadcast (identical to v2.1 by construction)

validation.alignment_metrics: lag error on accepted frames, precision of accepted frames (truly live and within 2 frames), recall over valid live frames

select_v4_only_if_all: default regime mean spellF1 >= v2.1 on the same copies (0.6312) + 0.010
accepted-frame precision >= 0.98 and median absolute lag error <= 2 frames in the default regime

limits_stated_in_advance: The broadcast stream is synthetic; real replay/cut structure, calibration error and the overlap of the two cameras' ball gaps are unknown and decide the real gain.
On the provided match the alignment is automatic; its outcome is reported only in the local run.json and is not used for any choice.
If selected, the final check is the Metrica game 3 reserved test with a synthetic broadcast, once.
